# Compatibility matrix

> Generated from [compatibility.json](data/compatibility.json) by `scripts/render_compatibility.py`; do not edit this file by hand. Change the register or a page in `docs/compatibility/`, then run the script; CI runs it with `--check`.

Status of each component against the Haskell reference (`cardano-node` 11.1.3, see
[reference-image.md](reference-image.md)), the evidence behind it, and what is explicitly **not**
checked. Unofficial, research software, not audited. "Verified" always means "agrees with the
evidence named in the row"; it is not a proof of equivalence. Roadmap IDs (A1, B3, ...) point into
[roadmap.md](roadmap.md).

Status values: **implemented**, **partial**, **not implemented**. The one-line summaries are orientation only: the evidence, and what is not checked, is on each component's page.

## Release support

Scarab uses its own SemVer; version numbers do not encode a cardano-node major or era. No release support row is declared yet, and the component matrix below describes source-level evidence, not blanket support for every release.

- [Release support](compatibility/release-support.md)

## Evidence kinds

Unit and property suites, golden and oracle fixtures, devnet scenarios, Preview sync and the ledger oracle (K1), the comparison and coverage register, and external candidate acceptance (#294).

- [Evidence kinds](compatibility/evidence-kinds.md)
